items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: I never just played with him.

ctx.x: And see, the time when I was going at the lake, I used to have six pieces. But they used to have three pieces of drag. I never just played with him. But we didn't, you know, we didn't, he would play with them just with the little fellas, Willie Phillip and all them different fellas.
